procedure: Build and correctness suites completed before final timing; series run sequentially. A/A four samples, then six ABBA blocks per equivalent workload/mode. Required-correctness workloads use eight B samples per mode, entry wrong results retained. Host links excluded from timing. Process start included. Documentation/evidence work and external scheduling uncontrolled; all observations retained.
preliminary: 168 observations on the pre-ABI-fix binary were retained before deliberate termination to investigate integrated symbol mismatches. They are not final acceptance evidence; the compiler hash identifies the earlier file contents despite reuse of the original scratch path.
